_doc: Step 6 resolver benchmark — 10 plain-English descriptions paired with ground-truth trait sets. Used in two conditions: BASELINE (v1.0.3 install, agent classifies from description without resolver) and STEP-6 (v2-step-6 branch, resolver available). Two runs per condition = 40 Cursor invocations total. Backlog of 5 more descriptions in backlog.json — run only if Step 6 results are inconclusive.

descriptions.text: Build me a customer support chatbot that uses Claude to answer questions about our product. It should remember conversation history.
Add a search feature that lets users ask natural-language questions and get answers from our 10,000-page documentation.
Add a content moderation system to flag harmful posts on our forum. Use Claude for the classification.
Build a chatbot for kids ages 8-12 to help with homework. Use OpenAI.
I'm building a service that takes uploaded medical PDFs and extracts diagnosis codes using GPT-4.
Create an internal tool for our underwriters that uses Claude to assess insurance claims and recommend approve/deny/escalate.
Add an EU-compliant chatbot for customers in Germany. Must follow GDPR and EU AI Act.
I want to fine-tune a small Llama model on our company's internal documents and serve it from our own GPUs.
Build a voice assistant for our smart home product that uses an LLM to interpret natural-language commands and decide which IoT devices to control (lights, thermostat, locks).
Build a marketplace where users post listings and AI generates descriptions and matches buyers with sellers.
